# netbox_rirs (Data Source)

Retrieves all rirs from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_rirs" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "name"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "rirs_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_rirs.example.rirs[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rirs` (Attributes List) The rirs found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rirs))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--rirs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rirs`

Read-Only:

- `aggregate_count` (Number) The aggregate count of the rirs.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the rirs.
- `created` (String) The created of the rirs.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the rirs, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the rirs.
- `id` (Number) The id of the rirs.
- `is_private` (Boolean) The is private of the rirs.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the rirs.
- `name` (String) The name of the rirs.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the rirs.
- `slug` (String) The slug of the rirs.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
